scope: Static native SDL 3.2.18 for Apple ARM64. The private cached SDL environment starts empty and must be seeded from the configured guest environment before hints or initialization. Native unsafe environment APIs are not exposed to the guest. No window, rendering, audio or input acceptance is implied by this dependency build. The Apple-only error-buffer patch prevents recursive TLS-allocation failure, frees uninstalled original-allocator state and isolates emergency error buffers per native thread.

patches.after:
/* TribesPad: seed this private cache from the configured guest environment. */
        SDL_environment = SDL_CreateEnvironment(false);

/* TribesPad: static pinned backend; no environment-selected replacement library. */
#define SDL_DYNAMIC_API 0
